## 升级前请阅读 / Before upgrading

- 从数据库谱系不兼容的旧版本跨代升级前，请备份或导出重要数据；应用沿用既有的数据集重建规则，不转换历史数据，Agent 数据清理保留非 Agent 配置。使用已退役 Computer 契约的会话需新建会话，原历史保留，个人 Agent 请重新选择 Computer 动作。
- Back up or export important data before upgrading from an incompatible older database lineage. Existing dataset rebuild rules remain in effect without converting historical data; Agent clean cuts preserve non-Agent configuration. Retired Computer bindings require a new session and reselected actions for personal Agents; existing history is retained.

## 更新内容 / Highlights

- SSH 新会话立即连接，新增显式连接/断开控制；可测试尚未保存的主机配置，不写入配置或更改已有连接。
- 修复删除会话、画布与 Agent 重置时的关联清理，保留应保留的历史、终态与消息身份。
- 改善浅色/深色主题下预览、聊天、设置和控件的对比度。
- 修复 macOS 升级时对旧版键盘 LaunchAgent 事件触发器的识别，并更新帮助入口微信群二维码。

- Connect new SSH sessions immediately, provide explicit connect/disconnect controls, and test unsaved host configurations without persisting them or changing existing links.
- Preserve lifecycle integrity across session/canvas deletion and Agent resets, including retained history, terminal state and message identity.
- Improve light/dark theme contrast and macOS legacy keyboard-service detection; refresh the WeChat help QR code.

## macOS 首发 / Initial macOS release

- [Apple Silicon（M 系列）安装包 / installer](https://github.com/nomifun/nomifun-desktop/releases/download/v0.8.20/NomiFun_0.8.20_aarch64.dmg)
- [Intel 安装包 / installer](https://github.com/nomifun/nomifun-desktop/releases/download/v0.8.20/NomiFun_0.8.20_x64.dmg)
- 系统要求 / Requires macOS 14.0 or later. 两种架构均提供 Developer ID 签名、公证及签名 updater，发布至 GitHub 和 CrabNebula Cloud。Both architectures include Developer ID signing, notarization and signed updater archives, published to GitHub and CrabNebula Cloud.
- 本次首发提供 macOS Apple Silicon 与 Intel，未构建 Windows、Linux 或 AppImage。This initial publication includes Apple Silicon and Intel macOS artifacts; Windows, Linux and AppImage are not built in this release.
- [SHA-256 校验和 / checksums](https://github.com/nomifun/nomifun-desktop/releases/download/v0.8.20/SHA256SUMS) · [发布验证记录 / validation record](https://github.com/nomifun/nomifun-desktop/releases/download/v0.8.20/release-validation-v0.8.20.json)
- Intel 包通过 Apple Silicon 上的 Rosetta 检查；实体 Intel、实体 macOS 14、桌面首次设置及旧安装的原生更新与重启未执行，详见验证记录。Intel package checks run through Rosetta on Apple Silicon; physical Intel/macOS 14, first-run GUI setup and native update installation/restart remain unexecuted, as recorded in the validation record.
